verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਅਣੁਬੋਲਣ ਅਭਿਰਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: ras bhariaa ras rakhadhaa bolan anubolan abhiriThaa|

en.bdb: Full of juice (sugarcane) is tasty and whether it speaks or not, in both the conditions, it is sweet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਅਣਸੁਣਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਅਣਡਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: suniaa anasuniaa karai kare veechaar ddiThaa anaddiThaa|

en.bdb: It listens not to what is said and sees not what is visible, i.e. in the sugarcane field one neither can listen to other nor a person  is visible in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਟਾਈਆ ਅਖੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: akhee dhooR aTaieeaa akhee vich a(n)goor bahiThaa|

en.bdb: When in the form of seed the nodes of sugarcane are put into the earth, they sprout up.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਬੂਟ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਇਠਹੁ ਇਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik dhoo baahale booT hoi sir talavaiaa iThahu iThaa|

en.bdb: From one sugarcane grow many a plant, each lovely from top to bottom.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਟੋਟੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਇਤੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਮਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh khu(n)ddaa vich peeReeaai ToTe laahe it gun miThaa|

en.bdb: It is crushed between two cylinderical rollers because of its sweet juice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਣਿਠਾ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh varatadhaa avaguniaare paap paniThaa|

en.bdb: Worthy people use it on auspicious days whereas the wicked also use it (by preparing wine etc out of it) and get perished.
Those who cultivated the nature of sugarcane i.e. do not  shed sweetness though in peril, are indeed steadfast persons.
